description: Is this store ready for ChatGPT shopping? Audit whether an online store is ready for AI shopping agents (ChatGPT shopping and Instant Checkout via ACP, Google AI Mode via UCP, Perplexity, Claude): AI bot access to product pages, Product structured data (price, currency, availability, GTIN/MPN, brand, ratings), return policy and shipping details, policy pages, product sitemap/feed, platform and Stripe detection, and agent protocol discovery files (/.well-known/ucp, /.well-known/acp.json, MCP server card). Returns a 0-100 score, readiness level and a prioritized fix list.

url.description: Store domain or a product page URL, e.g. "allbirds.com" or "https://shop.example.com/products/blue-mug".

name: agentic_commerce_readiness
title: Agentic commerce readiness (AI shopping agents)
